verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਛੀਂਬਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: naamaa chhee(n)baa aakheeaai gurmukh bhai bhagat liv laiee|

en.bdb: Namdev, the calico minter having become gurmukh merged his consciousness in loving devotion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਦੇਹੁਰੈ ਉਤਮ ਜਾਤਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: khatree brahaman dhehurai utam jaat karan vaddiaaiee|

en.bdb: High caste kshatriyas and Brahmins who went to temple to eulogize the Lord caught hold and ousted Namdev.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਪਕੜਿ ਉਠਾਲਿਆ ਬਹਿ ਪਿਛਵਾੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: naam pakaR uThaaliaa beh pichhavaaRai har gun gaiee|

en.bdb: While sitting in the back yard of the temple, he started singing the praises of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਵਛਲ ਆਖਾਇਦਾ ਫੇਰਿ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਪੈਜਿ ਰਖਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat vachhal aakhaidhaa fer dhehuraa paij rakhaiee|

en.bdb: The Lord known as kind to devotees turned the face of the temple towards him and maintained His own reputation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: dharageh maan nimaaniaa saadhasa(n)gat satigur saranaiee|

en.bdb: In the shelter of  holy congregation, the true Guru and the Lord, the humble ones also get honour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਤਮੁ ਪਦਵੀ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਚਾਰੇ ਵਰਣ ਪਏ ਪਗ ਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: autam padhavee neech jaat chaare varan pe pag aaiee|

en.bdb: High, ranking as well as the so-called low castes i.e. all the four as fell at the feet of Namdev
Just as the water flows down towards low
